lines.text: Asha's answer was two words: No thanks. Mira already had three reasons to change her mind.
Mira and Asha are fictional. It was an Atomy recommendation she hadn't asked for.
Mira began another reply, then read those two words again. Asha had already answered.
She deleted every reason. No problem. Lunch on Saturday? Her thumb moved to send.
Asha sent a laughing face. Saturday stayed on the calendar. No order followed. Just lunch between friends.
